campaign.title: Separate the exact M1 angular symbol into twisted divisor modes

conductor_policy.monitoring: Track Mellin conventions, divisor-variable powers, contour shifts, complex-shift uniformity, H_j floors, endpoint stars, and top-symbol tail decay.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after an exact separation, an analytic or no-go verdict, a source audit, and conductor graph adjudication.

numerical_purpose: bounded falsification of constants or endpoint conventions
resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary sources only for imported generalized divisor/Voronoi theorems.

exit_gates: twisted divisor Dirichlet series and parity
campaign.promotion_policy: Promote only exact formulas with uniform contour/error bounds or rigorously scoped no-go results. A formal Dirichlet series identity alone does not prove GAR.

closing_assessment.main_result: Exact double-Mellin separation gives shifted zeta-times-L divisor modes; their functional equation reflects z to -z, while the zero mode and fixed-mode Voronoi transformations are return maps.
